# Cineby (https://thecineby.org)
> Movie and TV discovery: ratings, cast, trailers and recommendations.

## Overview
Cineby helps people find something to watch. Title information comes from TMDB.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://thecineby.org/): Trending and popular titles
- [Browse Movies](https://thecineby.org/browse/movie): Movie catalog by genre and year
- [Browse TV Shows](https://thecineby.org/browse/tv): TV catalog by genre
- [Blog](https://thecineby.org/blog): Guides and news
- [Privacy Policy](https://thecineby.org/privacy): Data handling
- [Terms of Service](https://thecineby.org/terms): Terms of use

## Crawling Policy
Search and retrieval bots (`OAI-SearchBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`) follow the rules in `/robots.txt`.
Bulk training crawlers (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`) are blocked there.
